title: Frittata
description: Fluffy Italian omelette baked with potato, onion, pancetta and Parmesan.
instructions: Cook pancetta, potato and onion in olive oil in an oven-safe pan until soft.
Whisk eggs with Parmesan, parsley, salt and pepper.
Pour eggs over the vegetables and cook on low heat for 5 minutes until the edges set.
Bake at 190°C for 8-10 minutes until puffed and golden.
Rest 3 minutes, slice into wedges and serve warm.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Italian Croissant (Cornetto)
description: Buttery Italian croissant with a lightly sweet dough scented with orange and vanilla.
ingredients: Apricot jam or custard to fill
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, milk, egg, zest and vanilla into a smooth dough and chill 1 hour.
Roll out, enclose the cold butter and give two letter folds, chilling between each.
Roll to 5 mm, cut long triangles and roll each from the wide end into a crescent.
Proof 1 hour until puffy and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 190°C for 15-18 minutes until golden; fill with jam or custard if you like.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Ricotta Pancakes
description: Cloud-soft pancakes made with creamy ricotta and a hint of lemon.
instructions: Whisk ricotta, yolks, milk, sugar and lemon zest.
Stir in flour and baking powder until just combined.
Whip the whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the batter.
Cook scoops in a buttered pan over medium-low heat, 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve with honey and fresh berries.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Cappuccino French Toast
description: Thick brioche soaked in espresso custard and dusted with cocoa.
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, espresso, sugar and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Soak each brioche slice for 30 seconds per side.
Fry in butter over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Top with whipped cream and dust with cocoa.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
description: Grilled rustic bread rubbed with garlic and topped with ripe tomatoes and basil.
instructions: Toss tomatoes with basil, oil, vinegar and salt; rest 10 minutes.
Grill or toast the bread until crisp and charred at the edges.
Rub each slice with a halved garlic clove.
Spoon tomatoes on top and drizzle with olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Italian Baked Eggs
description: Eggs baked in spicy tomato sauce with Parmesan, known as uova in purgatorio.
instructions: Sauté garlic and chilli in olive oil, add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 5-7 minutes, or bake at 190°C, until the whites set.
Top with basil and Parmesan and serve with bread.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Bomboloni
description: Fluffy Italian doughnuts rolled in sugar and filled with custard.
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, milk, eggs and butter; knead 8 minutes until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour until doubled.
Roll to 2 cm, cut rounds and proof 30 minutes.
Fry in 170°C oil for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Roll in sugar, then pipe in pastry cream.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Prosciutto and Cheese Panini
description: Crispy pressed ciabatta with prosciutto crudo and melting fontina.
instructions: Slice rolls and spread lightly with mustard.
Layer cheese, prosciutto and arugula.
Brush the outside with olive oil.
Press in a panini press or heavy skillet for 4-5 minutes until crisp and melted.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Spinach and Ricotta Omelette
description: Soft omelette folded around garlicky spinach and creamy ricotta.
instructions: Wilt spinach with garlic in a little butter and squeeze dry.
Mix spinach with ricotta, a pinch of nutmeg and salt.
Beat eggs, pour into a hot buttered pan and cook gently.
Spoon filling onto one half, fold over and top with Parmesan.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Italian Breakfast Sandwich
description: Toasted focaccia with fried egg, mortadella and mozzarella.
instructions: Split and toast the focaccia.
Fry eggs in olive oil until the whites are set.
Layer mortadella, mozzarella and arugula on the base.
Top with eggs, close the sandwich and press lightly.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Margherita Pizza
description: Neapolitan-style pizza with San Marzano tomato, mozzarella and basil.
instructions: Mix flour, water, salt and yeast; knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour.
Divide into balls and rest 20 more minutes.
Stretch each ball by hand into a thin round.
Top with tomatoes and torn mozzarella; bake at your oven's highest setting (250°C+) for 6-8 minutes.
Finish with basil and olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: The Roman classic with guanciale, eggs and Pecorino. No cream.
instructions: Crisp the guanciale slowly in a dry pan.
Whisk yolks, egg, Pecorino and plenty of pepper.
Boil spaghetti until al dente and reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with guanciale off the heat, then stir in the egg mix with splashes of pasta water until creamy.
Serve immediately with extra Pecorino.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Lasagna alla Bolognese
description: Layers of slow ragù, béchamel and pasta baked until bubbling.
ingredients: 1 onion, 1 carrot and 1 celery stick, finely chopped
4 tbsp butter, 4 tbsp flour and 3 cups milk for béchamel
instructions: Brown the meat, add the soffritto, wine and passata, then simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, then add milk until thick.
Layer sauce, pasta, béchamel and Parmesan in a dish, repeating.
Bake at 180°C for 35-40 minutes until golden.
Rest 15 minutes before cutting.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Chicken Parmigiana
description: Crispy breaded chicken topped with marinara and melted mozzarella.
instructions: Dip chicken in egg, then in breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Fry in olive oil until golden, 3-4 minutes per side.
Top with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake at 200°C for 10-12 minutes until bubbly and garnish with basil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Caprese Salad
description: Ripe tomato, buffalo mozzarella and basil with good olive oil.
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella evenly.
Arrange alternating with basil leaves on a plate.
Season with salt and drizzle with olive oil and glaze.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Pesto Pasta
description: Pasta tossed with fresh Genovese basil pesto.
instructions: Blitz basil, pine nuts, garlic, Parmesan and oil into a pesto.
Boil pasta (with potato and beans if using) until al dente.
Toss pasta with pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Serve with extra Parmesan.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Panini al Prosciutto
description: Warm pressed panini with prosciutto, mozzarella and sun-dried tomato.
instructions: Fill rolls with mozzarella, prosciutto, tomatoes and basil.
Brush the outside with olive oil.
Grill in a press for 4 minutes until the cheese melts.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Ravioli Ricotta e Spinaci
description: Handmade pasta pillows filled with ricotta and spinach in sage butter.
instructions: Make dough from flour and eggs; knead and rest 30 minutes.
Mix ricotta, spinach, Parmesan, nutmeg and salt for the filling.
Roll the dough thin, place teaspoons of filling, cover, seal and cut.
Boil 3-4 minutes until they float.
Toss in browned sage butter and serve.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Gnocchi al Pomodoro
description: Pillowy potato gnocchi in a simple basil tomato sauce.
instructions: Boil potatoes whole, peel and rice them while hot.
Mix with flour, egg and salt into a soft dough; roll into ropes and cut.
Simmer garlic in oil, add passata and cook 15 minutes.
Boil gnocchi until they float, about 2 minutes.
Toss with sauce, basil and Parmesan.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Italian Minestrone Soup
description: Hearty vegetable and bean soup with small pasta and a Parmesan rind.
ingredients: 1 onion, 1 carrot and 1 celery stick, diced
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in oil for 8 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, stock and Parmesan rind; simmer 20 minutes.
Add beans and pasta; cook 10 minutes more.
Remove the rind, stir in basil and serve with olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Silky fettuccine tossed in butter and Parmigiano-Reggiano.
instructions: Boil fettuccine until al dente and save 1 cup pasta water.
Melt butter (and cream) in a wide pan.
Add pasta, Parmesan and splashes of pasta water; toss until glossy.
Finish with pepper and nutmeg.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Risotto alla Milanese
description: Golden saffron risotto, creamy and rich with Parmesan.
ingredients: 1 litre hot beef or vegetable stock
instructions: Steep saffron in a little hot stock.
Sweat onion in half the butter and toast the rice for 2 minutes.
Add wine, then stock ladle by ladle, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
Stir in saffron, remaining butter and Parmesan until creamy.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Osso Buco
description: Braised veal shanks with white wine and vegetables, finished with gremolata.
ingredients: Gremolata: lemon zest, garlic and parsley
instructions: Tie, season and flour the shanks; brown in oil and butter.
Soften the vegetables, then add wine, stock and tomatoes.
Return shanks, cover and braise at 160°C for 2 hours.
Mix the gremolata and sprinkle over before serving with risotto.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Chicken Piccata
description: Pan-fried chicken cutlets in a lemon, caper and white wine sauce.
instructions: Flour the cutlets and sear in oil and butter, 3 minutes per side; set aside.
Deglaze with wine, add stock, lemon juice and capers; reduce by half.
Swirl in cold butter, return the chicken and spoon sauce over.
Garnish with parsley.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Eggplant Parmigiana
description: Layers of fried aubergine, tomato sauce, basil and mozzarella.
instructions: Slice eggplant, salt for 30 minutes and pat dry.
Fry or roast the slices until golden.
Layer sauce, eggplant, basil, mozzarella and Parmesan in a dish.
Bake at 190°C for 30 minutes until bubbling and browned.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Slow-simmered meat ragù over spaghetti, loved around the world.
instructions: Render the pancetta, add the soffritto and cook until soft.
Brown the beef, stir in paste and wine, then reduce.
Add tomatoes and milk and simmer on low for 1 1/2 hours.
Toss with al dente spaghetti and Parmesan.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Seafood Linguine
description: Linguine with clams, mussels and prawns in garlic white wine sauce.
instructions: Sizzle garlic and chilli in oil; add tomatoes and wine.
Add clams and mussels, cover until they open, 4-5 minutes; add prawns for the last 2 minutes.
Toss in al dente linguine with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parsley and olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Four Cheese Pizza
description: Pizza quattro formaggi with mozzarella, gorgonzola, fontina and Parmesan.
instructions: Stretch the dough and brush with olive oil.
Scatter all four cheeses evenly.
Bake at 250°C for 7-9 minutes until blistered.
Finish with herbs.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Beef Braciole
description: Thin beef rolls stuffed with Parmesan, garlic and herbs, braised in tomato sauce.
instructions: Pound the beef thin and spread with breadcrumbs, Parmesan, garlic and parsley.
Roll up and tie with twine.
Brown the rolls in olive oil, add wine and let it reduce.
Pour in sauce, cover and simmer 1 1/2-2 hours.
Remove twine and serve with pasta.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy risotto with porcini and cremini mushrooms.
instructions: Sauté the mushrooms until golden and set aside.
Sweat the shallot, toast the rice and add wine.
Add stock and the porcini soaking liquid gradually for 18 minutes.
Fold in mushrooms, butter and Parmesan.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Vegan Margherita Pizza
description: Classic Margherita with cashew mozzarella and fresh basil.
ingredients: 1 cup vegan mozzarella or cashew cheese
instructions: Stretch the dough into a round.
Spread tomatoes and dot with vegan mozzarella.
Bake at 250°C for 7-8 minutes.
Top with basil and olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Pasta alla Norma
description: Sicilian pasta with fried eggplant, tomato and basil.
instructions: Fry the eggplant in olive oil until golden.
Simmer garlic, chilli and passata for 15 minutes.
Toss al dente rigatoni with the sauce and eggplant.
Top with basil and toasted breadcrumbs.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: Garlic, chilli and olive oil: five ingredients, fifteen minutes.
instructions: Boil spaghetti and reserve pasta water.
Gently fry garlic in oil until pale gold, then add chilli.
Toss pasta in the oil with pasta water until emulsified.
Finish with parsley.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Vegan Pesto Pasta
description: Basil pesto made with toasted pine nuts and nutritional yeast.
instructions: Blend basil, nuts, yeast, garlic, oil and lemon.
Cook the pasta and reserve some water.
Toss with pesto and a little water until glossy.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Ribollita
description: Tuscan twice-boiled bread and kale soup.
instructions: Soften the soffritto and garlic in olive oil.
Add kale, tomatoes, beans and stock; simmer 40 minutes.
Tear in the stale bread and stir until thick.
Rest, then serve drizzled with olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Tuscan White Bean Soup
description: Creamy cannellini soup with rosemary and garlic.
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and rosemary in oil.
Add beans and stock; simmer 25 minutes.
Blend half the soup and stir it back in.
Serve with bread and olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Vegan Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy dairy-free risotto with porcini and nutritional yeast.
instructions: Sauté the mushrooms in olive oil until golden; set aside.
Sweat the shallot, toast the rice and add wine.
Add stock and porcini liquid gradually for 18 minutes.
Fold in mushrooms and nutritional yeast.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Pasta e Ceci
description: Rustic Roman pasta and chickpea stew with rosemary.
instructions: Sizzle garlic, rosemary and chilli in oil; stir in tomato paste.
Add chickpeas and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Mash a third of the chickpeas for creaminess.
Add pasta and cook until tender; finish with olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Roasted Vegetable Bruschetta
description: Charred bread piled with roasted peppers, zucchini and eggplant.
instructions: Dice the vegetables, toss in oil and roast at 220°C for 20 minutes.
Toast the bread and rub with garlic.
Dress the vegetables with balsamic and basil.
Pile onto the toasts and drizzle with olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Vegan Eggplant Parmigiana
description: Baked eggplant layers with tomato sauce and a golden almond-breadcrumb crust.
instructions: Slice and roast the eggplant until tender.
Layer sauce, eggplant, basil and vegan mozzarella in a dish.
Mix breadcrumbs, almonds and oil and scatter on top.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until golden.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Tiramisu
description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with whipped mascarpone cream.
instructions: Whisk yolks and sugar over a bain-marie until thick; cool, then beat in mascarpone.
Mix espresso with marsala.
Dip ladyfingers quickly and layer in a dish, then cover with cream; repeat.
Chill at least 6 hours and dust with cocoa before serving.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Panna Cotta
description: Silky cooked cream dessert with berry coulis.
instructions: Bloom the gelatin in cold water.
Heat cream, milk, sugar and vanilla until steaming; stir in gelatin.
Pour into glasses and chill 4 hours until set.
Serve with berry coulis.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Cannoli Siciliani
description: Crisp fried shells filled with sweet ricotta and chocolate chips.
instructions: Make a stiff dough from flour, sugar, butter and Marsala; rest 1 hour.
Roll thin, cut circles and wrap around cannoli tubes.
Fry at 180°C until bubbly and golden; cool and slide off.
Beat ricotta with powdered sugar and fold in chocolate chips.
Pipe filling just before serving and dip ends in pistachio.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Classic Italian Gelato
description: Dense, silky custard gelato, churned slowly.
instructions: Heat milk, cream and vanilla until steaming.
Whisk yolks and sugar, temper with hot milk and cook to 82°C.
Strain, chill overnight.
Churn in an ice-cream machine and freeze 2 hours.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Affogato
description: Hot espresso poured over vanilla gelato.
instructions: Place gelato in a chilled glass.
Pour the hot espresso over at the table.
Top with crushed amaretti.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Italian Ricotta Cheesecake
description: Light baked cheesecake with ricotta, lemon and a crumbly base.
instructions: Press the crumb base into a tin and chill.
Beat ricotta, sugar, eggs, zest and flour until smooth.
Pour onto the base.
Bake at 170°C for 45 minutes; cool in the oven.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Sfogliatelle
description: Shell-shaped crisp pastry with semolina and ricotta filling.
ingredients: Filling: 1 cup semolina cooked in milk, 1 cup ricotta, 1/2 cup sugar, candied orange peel, cinnamon
instructions: Make a firm dough, rest, then roll paper-thin and brush with lard.
Roll into a tight log and chill overnight.
Slice, shape into cones and fill with the cooled semolina-ricotta mixture.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes and dust with sugar.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Zeppole
description: Fried choux doughnuts topped with custard and amarena cherries.
instructions: Boil water and butter, add flour and stir into a ball; cool slightly.
Beat in eggs one at a time to a glossy paste.
Pipe rings onto paper and fry in 170°C oil until golden.
Top with pastry cream, cherries and sugar.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Crostata di Frutta
description: Buttery pasta frolla tart with pastry cream and fresh fruit.
instructions: Rub butter into flour and sugar; bind with yolks and chill 30 minutes.
Line a tart tin and blind bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
Fill with pastry cream and arrange the fruit.
Warm the jam and brush on top.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Chocolate Budino
description: Rich Italian chocolate pudding with whipped cream.
instructions: Whisk sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and salt with the milk.
Cook while stirring until thick.
Melt in the chocolate until glossy.
Pour into cups, chill 2 hours and top with cream.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Arancini
description: Crispy Sicilian rice balls stuffed with ragù and mozzarella.
instructions: Mix cooled rice with Parmesan and an egg.
Shape around a spoonful of ragù and a cube of mozzarella.
Dip in beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 175°C for 4-5 minutes until golden.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Garlic Bread
description: Crusty bread with garlic-parsley butter, baked until crisp.
instructions: Mix butter, garlic, parsley and salt.
Slice bread and spread with the butter.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until crisp.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Focaccia
description: Dimpled, olive-oil-rich bread with rosemary and sea salt.
instructions: Mix flour, water, salt and yeast into a sticky dough; rest 2 hours.
Pour oil into a tray and stretch the dough in; proof 1 hour.
Dimple with oily fingers and add rosemary and salt.
Bake at 220°C for 22-25 minutes until golden.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Fried Mozzarella Sticks
description: Golden breaded mozzarella with marinara dip.
instructions: Freeze the cheese sticks for 1 hour.
Coat in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs; repeat for a thick crust.
Fry at 180°C for 1-2 minutes until golden.
Serve at once with marinara.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Calamari Fritti
description: Light and crispy fried squid with lemon.
ingredients: 500g squid, cleaned and cut into rings
instructions: Pat the squid dry.
Mix flour and semolina and toss the rings in it.
Fry in 190°C oil for 1-2 minutes until golden.
Season with salt and serve with lemon.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Bruschetta
description: Toasted bread with garlic, olive oil and tomato.
instructions: Toast or grill the bread.
Rub with garlic.
Top with chopped salted tomatoes and basil.
Finish with olive oil.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Grissini
description: Thin, crisp breadsticks from Turin.
instructions: Knead all ingredients to a smooth dough; rest 30 minutes.
Cut into strips and roll thin on semolina.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until crisp and golden.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Panzerotti
description: Puglian fried pockets filled with tomato and mozzarella.
instructions: Make a soft dough; rise 1 hour.
Roll thin and cut rounds.
Fill with sauce and mozzarella, fold and seal firmly.
Fry at 180°C until puffed and golden.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Olive all'Ascolana
description: Fried olives stuffed with seasoned meat from Ascoli Piceno.
ingredients: Flour, egg and breadcrumbs to coat
instructions: Brown the meat and mix with Parmesan, egg and nutmeg.
Stuff each olive with the meat mixture.
Coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 175°C for 3 minutes until golden.
author: The Culinary Corner

title: Parmesan Crisps
description: Lacy, crunchy baked Parmigiano-Reggiano crisps.
instructions: Heat oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper.
Mound tablespoons of cheese and flatten slightly.
Sprinkle with pepper and oregano.
Bake 5-6 minutes until golden; cool to crisp.
author: The Culinary Corner
